name: Franklin's lost expedition
traveler: Sir John Franklin and the crews of the Erebus and Terror
summary: The best-equipped Arctic expedition Britain had sent sails to find the last link of the Northwest Passage and vanishes with all 129 men. The searches that followed mapped much of the Arctic archipelago. In 1854 John Rae learned from Inuit what had happened; in 1859 a note found at Victory Point told the rest, and the wrecks of the ships were found in 2014 and 2016.

stops.note: The Erebus and Terror leave the Thames.
Supplies taken on; letters sent home for the last time.
Last seen by two whalers, moored to an iceberg.
The first winter; three men are buried here.
Beset in the ice of Victoria Strait, never to be freed.
The survivors abandon the ships and leave a note in a cairn.
The last of them die marching south.
